name: Terrestrial
description: Land-based environments including forests, grasslands and deserts.

name: Freshwater
description: Freshwater environments including rivers, lakes and wetlands.

name: Marine
description: Saltwater environments from coastal shelves to the open and deep ocean.

name: Transitional
description: Land-water interfaces such as estuaries, mangroves and salt marshes.

name: Anthropogenic
description: Human-modified environments including agricultural, urban and industrial systems.

name: Subterranean
description: Below-ground environments including caves, karst systems and groundwater.

name: Cryospheric
description: Permanently or seasonally frozen environments such as glaciers and permafrost.

name: Atmospheric
description: Airborne environments sampled for suspended biological material.

name: Coastal
description: Nearshore environments influenced by both marine and terrestrial processes.

name: Extreme
description: Environments with extreme chemistry or temperature, including hydrothermal and hypersaline systems.
